endpoint.text: Primary endpoint: overall response rate (complete response and partial response) assessed by an independent review committee using the International Workshop Criteria; key secondary endpoint duration of response

citations.quote: The primary efficacy endpoint was response rate (complete response and partial response) as assessed by an independent review committee (IRC) using the International Workshop Criteria (IWC) (Cheson 2007). The key secondary efficacy endpoint was duration of response.
There were 120 patients who had histologically confirmed PTCL by central review evaluable for efficacy.

result.text: Overall response rate 25.8% (31/120; 95% CI 18.3-34.6); CR 10.8% (13/120); PR 15.0% (18/120); median duration of response 8.4 months (95% CI 4.5-29.4)

citations.quote: The median duration of response based on the first date of response to disease progression or death was 8.4 months (95% CI: 4.5 – 29.4).
